behaviors.semantics: Protocol-module RPC sends/replies may be delayed, dropped or delivered in different orders across independent sends. Message payloads are not changed. Same-connection TCP ordering is not claimed at this boundary.
At most one node is isolated at a time during the fault phase; directional edges may stop progress. Every edge heals before recovery; no immediate membership notification.
Election/heartbeat timers expire at or after actual configured deadlines; eligible RPC and timeout handlers can run in either order. Clocks advance during recovery.
Independently runnable native implementation tasks retain shared state and real synchronization; observation must not add serialization.

recovery: Faults cease; all configured nodes/connections are healthy and clocks advance. Every continuously enabled task, submitted IO/delivery and due timer progresses within 1000 selected eligible events. Grace is 20 maximum configured election timeouts including upstream jitter, then completion of the declared healthy-phase writes. A violated fairness bound invalidates a liveness judgment; a host watchdog is not a target failure.
exclusions: full production service transport/framing outside the stated module boundary
